lemma_statement: (w : Valuation A Gamma0) (I : Ideal A) : Spv.IsInSpvAI (ofValuation (w.restrictIdeal I)) I
b2_reason: False as stated for the current cGammaIdeal encoding. cGammaIdeal v I = minContain(cGammaIdealUnits v I) UNCONDITIONALLY adjoins the ideal generators (second clause), diverging from Wedhorn Def 7.3 (wedhorn.txt:2942) which sets cGamma_v(I)=cGamma_v whenever v(I) cap cGamma_v != empty and adjoins ideal generators ONLY when v(I) cap cGamma_v = empty. On the divergent case both disjuncts of IsInSpvAI fail.
counterexample: A=k(y)[x]; w = rank-2 composite valuation (x-adic, then y-adic on residue field k(y)), value group ZxZ lex; I=(x-1). cGamma_w = <(0,1)> is PROPER ((0,1)=w(1/y)). b2:=x-1 in I has w(b2)=1 in cGamma_w (so v(I) cap cGamma_w != empty); restrictIdeal preserves it so rw(b2)=1 and CofinalValue rw b2 FAILS (1^n=1 not < gamma for gamma<1) => left disjunct false. b1:=x(x-1) in I has w(b1)=(-1,0) cofinal below cGamma_w; preserved, so Gamma_rw strictly contains cGamma_w=cGamma_rw => rw NOT microbial (gamma=(1,0) has no witness) => right disjunct false. Honest fix: correct cGammaIdeal to Wedhorn Def 7.3 case-split, OR restrict lemma to v(I) cap cGamma_v = empty (permitted, result genuinely false without it).
